Council approves the river trail extension

18.10.2026

The extension adds four kilometres of paved path along the north bank, linking the boat launch to the old mill bridge. Work starts in the spring and the trail should open by the end of next summer.

The harvest market returns to the square

12.10.2026

Thirty vendors are booked for the first weekend, from orchard stands to a cider press. The market runs every Saturday morning until the end of November, rain or shine, under the new canopy.

Three new bus routes start Monday

30.09.2026

Routes 14, 22 and 31 add evening service to the east side and a direct run to the college. Riders can plan trips with the updated schedule posted at every shelter and on the transit site.

School garden wins a provincial grant

22.09.2026

The grant pays for raised beds, a tool shed and a rain barrel at the elementary school. Students will grow vegetables for the lunch program and sell the rest at the harvest market.

Rowing club hosts its first regatta

15.09.2026

Eleven crews from across the valley raced on the lake on Saturday morning. The home club took two of the five finals and plans to make the regatta a yearly event from next season.

The library extends its weekend hours

08.09.2026

From October the main branch opens at nine on Saturdays and stays open until five on Sundays. The longer hours follow a survey in which most readers asked for more weekend time.
